lines.zh: 我踩着浅水走，脚环叮当。
lines.en: I wade the shallows, my steps tinkling.

lines.zh: 我一步一低头，看水里的鱼。
lines.en: I dip my head at every step, watching fish.

lines.zh: 细长的腿在沙上留下小洞。
lines.en: My thin legs leave small holes in the sand.
I walk slowly along the line of foam.
The sand is hot, so I switch feet.
I open my wings to keep my balance.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方水花很小。
lines.en: My passing barely raises a splash.

lines.zh: 风把我的羽毛吹得蓬松。
lines.en: The wind fluffs out my feathers.
I stretch my neck to see ahead.
The tide pulls back and bares the sand.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，像在数贝壳。
lines.en: I step as if counting shells.

lines.zh: 我踩进一个水洼，凉了一下。
lines.en: I step in a puddle and feel the chill.
My shadow wavers on the water.
I reach the water and turn back.

lines.zh: 我在湿沙上留下三趾的印。
lines.en: My three-toed prints trail across the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，找浅水里的虾。
lines.en: I walk with my head low, hunting shrimp in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，站着不动。
lines.en: I lift one leg and hold still.

lines.zh: 单腿站着，比两条腿舒服。
lines.en: One leg feels better than two.
I tuck my beak into my feathers.

lines.zh: 我理了理胸前的粉色羽毛。
lines.en: I preen the pink feathers on my chest.
The water is still; I watch it long.
I suddenly honk, loud and sharp.

lines.zh: 旁边的鸟被我吓了一跳。
lines.en: The bird beside me startles.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把腿放下，又抬起。
lines.en: I lower my leg slowly, then lift it again.
The sound of waves makes me drowsy.
I comb my wingtips with my beak.

lines.zh: 一只螃蟹从我脚边爬过。
lines.en: A crab scuttles by, right at my toes.
I tilt my head as it burrows into sand.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的背晒得暖暖的。
lines.en: The sun settles warm across my back.
I am waiting for the tide to bring fish.
You have stood on the beach a long while.
I tilt my head at the bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 你有鱼的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of fish; I caught it.
I take two steps toward you and stop.

lines.zh: 你的影子吓跑了我的鱼。
lines.en: Your shadow scared off my fish.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，但我也不靠近。
lines.en: I fear you not, nor do I come close.
I stand on one leg and watch you.

lines.zh: 你一挥手，我脖子就缩了。
lines.en: You wave, and my neck pulls in.
You crouch by the water like a stone.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一条浪线对看。
lines.en: We watch each other across a line of foam.

lines.zh: 你衣服上有太阳的味道。
lines.en: Your clothes carry the smell of sun.
I blink once; you have not moved.
Your feet are sinking into wet sand.
I am headed for the water; step aside.
My feathers are torn out of place.
That blow landed on my wing.
My honk splits my own throat.
I hop back on one leg.

lines.zh: 血滴在沙上，很快渗进去。
lines.en: Blood drips on sand and sinks in fast.
I cannot fly; I can only run.
Pain curls my neck into a knot.
My thin legs will not stop shaking.
I retreat to the water, where it is safe.
This one stays in my memory.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在滴水，我盯着。
lines.en: The fish still drips, and I stare.
My neck shoots out toward it.
The fishy smell drifts down the wind.
Three steps, a pause, then three more.
You raise the fish beyond my reach.
I open my beak and close it again.
This fish is fatter than the shallows hold.
Put the fish down and step back.
I grab the fish and shake my head.
Swallowing it whole, I choke a little.
Done eating, I still watch your hands.
Fish can lure me, but not keep me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了半片沙滩。
lines.en: I follow you halfway down the beach.

lines.zh: 再给一条，我就再站会儿。
lines.en: One more fish and I will linger.
You bump me and my wings fly open.
My thin legs nearly tangle.
I stumble two steps into the water.
Do not crowd me; the beach is wide.
I flap to steady myself.
Your knee knocks against my beak.
I back off and lose a feather.
That bump makes me honk out loud.
I go around you to the water's edge.
After the bump I settle on one leg.

lines.zh: 沙滩那头有只火烈鸟看我。
lines.en: A flamingo down the beach is watching me.
I straighten my neck and walk over.
We stand side by side in the shallows.
I bow my head, and so does it.

lines.zh: 我们的脖子弯成一样的弧。
lines.en: Our necks curve in the same arc.
I bring it a small fish.
Its feathers are redder than mine.
We stand on one leg together.
The tide washes over our feet.

lines.zh: 我们叫了一声，像在答应。
lines.en: We honk once, like an answer.
I dip my head and pick up a feather.

lines.zh: 这个亮亮的东西是什么。
lines.en: What is this shiny thing?
I nudge it with my beak.
It is too smooth; I cannot hold it.
I flip the shell over.
A strand of seaweed wraps my beak.
I shake my head and fling it off.
I carry the feather a few steps.
One taste proves it is not fish; I spit.
I leave it by the water and go.
Something stirs beneath the water.

lines.zh: 一只螃蟹夹住了我的鱼。
lines.en: A crab has grabbed my fish.
I lower my beak and aim at it.
It scuttles sideways; I turn with it.
A shadow flickers along the bottom.
I stretch my neck and fix on that spot.
A gull wants to steal my meal.
I spread my wings and drive it back.
It retreats, and I fold my wings.
This is not worth a chase.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，脖子一动不动。
lines.en: I watch it, neck perfectly still.

lines.zh: 它一挪，我的头就跟着挪。
lines.en: It shifts, and my head shifts after.
I close in with silent steps.
It slips into a crack in the rock.
I walk half around the rock.
When it peeks out, my beak darts.
A splash blocks my view for a moment.
I wait; I have more patience.
It runs, and I do not chase far.
Target gone; I preen my feathers.
My beak raps against its shell.
It pinches my toe.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下去，水花四溅。
lines.en: I stomp and water sprays everywhere.
I beat my wings and knock it over.
This peck is quick and exact.
It flips over and keeps struggling.
I back off; I will not dirty my feathers.
It escapes into the water; I do not follow.
A scratch shows on my leg.

lines.zh: 打完我叫了一声，像赢了。
lines.en: Afterward I honk as if I won.

lines.zh: 潮水把我带到这片沙滩。
lines.en: The tide brought me to this beach.
The sand is fine and the water shallow.
I shake the droplets from my wings.
A flock of flamingos stands far off.

lines.zh: 我朝它们的方向走了几步。
lines.en: I take a few steps toward them.
The sun has just cleared the sea.

lines.zh: 我在水边留下第一个脚印。
lines.en: I leave my first print by the water.
The wind carries salt and fish.
Here I can stand and here I can feed.
I settle on one leg and wait for the tide.
Fire curls the tips of my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，摔在沙上。
lines.en: I drop from the air onto the sand.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喙，我拍翅乱蹬。
lines.en: Water fills my beak; I flap and kick.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀进浪里。
lines.en: A blast throws me into the surf.
An arrow clips the very tip of my wing.

lines.zh: 紫光缠住我的腿，我站不住。
lines.en: Purple light binds my legs and I cannot stand.
Hunger makes my neck look thinner.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，我吓得趴下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and I flatten down.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，翅膀抓不住风。
lines.en: I fall, wings catching no air.
